description: Start learning a writing persona from recent posts — either a connected account (instagram, twitter, youtube) or a public profile (youtube, medium, mastodon, bluesky). Fetches the posts and analyses them with AI in the background (counts against the plan's AI image allowance, for the persona cover); returns a job id to poll with get_persona_job_status.

identifier.description: Required for public_profile — the profile handle or URL (max 300 characters).

platform.description: connected_account: instagram, twitter, youtube. public_profile: youtube, medium, mastodon, bluesky.

source_kind.description: Learn from one of the user's connected accounts, or from a public profile.

name: create_persona
